One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. The desk only stamps a name that carries Woadbound dye bookseller woad seal, and the stamp itself rests on a seal dye booksellers renew after dyehouse hearings. The wander is on the docket.
